<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="tr">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Taha Mert Dülger</title>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Bebas+Neue&family=Inter:wght@300;400;500&family=Space+Mono&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
*,*::before,*::after{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box}
:root{
  --black:#0d0d0d;
  --white:#f5f0e8;
  --red:#e63329;
  --gray:#888;
  --border:#d4ccbb;
}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{background:var(--white);color:var(--black);font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;font-size:14px;overflow-x:hidden}

/* Nav */
nav{position:fixed;top:0;width:100%;z-index:100;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:1.4rem 2.5rem;transition:all .4s}
nav.scrolled{background:var(--white);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)}
.nav-name{font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:1.3rem;letter-spacing:.12em;color:var(--black);text-decoration:none}
nav ul{list-style:none;display:flex;gap:2rem}
nav a{color:var(--gray);text-decoration:none;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;transition:color .2s}
nav a:hover{color:var(--red)}

/* Hero */
#hero{min-height:100vh;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)}
.hero-left{padding:8rem 2.5rem 3rem;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:flex-end;border-right:1px solid var(--border)}
.hero-tag{font-family:'Space Mono',monospace;font-size:10px;color:var(--red);letter-spacing:.2em;margin-bottom:1.5rem;opacity:0;animation:up .8s .2s forwards}
h1{font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:clamp(5rem,10vw,9.5rem);line-height:.88;letter-spacing:.02em;opacity:0;animation:up .9s .35s forwards}
.hero-desc{margin-top:2.5rem;color:var(--gray);line-height:1.8;max-width:340px;font-size:13px;opacity:0;animation:up .8s .6s forwards}
.hero-cta{margin-top:2.5rem;opacity:0;animation:up .8s .8s forwards}
.btn{display:inline-block;padding:.8rem 2rem;background:var(--black);color:var(--white);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.15em;text-transform:uppercase;text-decoration:none;transition:all .25s}
.btn:hover{background:var(--red)}
.hero-right{position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:var(--black)}
.hero-img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:center top;display:block}
.hero-overlay{position:absolute;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;padding:2rem;background:linear-gradient(transparent,rgba(0,0,0,.7))}
.hero-stats{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-end}
.stat-val{font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:4rem;color:var(--white);line-height:1}
.stat-label{font-size:10px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.5);letter-spacing:.15em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:.4rem}

/* Marquee */
.marquee-wrap{border-top:1px solid var(--border);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);overflow:hidden;padding:.75rem 0;background:var(--red)}
.marquee-inner{display:flex;width:max-content;animation:marquee 20s linear infinite}
.marquee-inner span{font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:1.1rem;letter-spacing:.2em;color:var(--white);padding:0 2rem}

/* Section base */
section{border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)}
.s-head{display:grid;grid-template-columns:80px 1fr;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)}
.s-num{padding:1.2rem;border-right:1px solid var(--border);font-family:'Space Mono',monospace;font-size:11px;color:var(--red);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;letter-spacing:.1em;writing-mode:vertical-rl}
.s-title{padding:1.2rem 2rem;font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:2.5rem;letter-spacing:.06em;display:flex;align-items:center}

/* About */
.about-body{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
.about-text-col{padding:3rem 2.5rem;border-right:1px solid var(--border)}
.about-big{font-size:1.2rem;font-weight:300;line-height:1.8;color:var(--black)}
.about-big strong{font-weight:500}
.meta-item{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:1.2rem 2rem;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);font-size:13px}
.meta-k{color:var(--gray);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase}
.meta-v{font-weight:500}

/* Experience */
.exp-item{display:grid;grid-template-columns:80px 1fr 1fr;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);transition:background .2s}
.exp-item:hover{background:#eee9df}
.exp-num-col{padding:1.5rem;border-right:1px solid var(--border);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.exp-num{font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:1.8rem;color:#ccc}
.exp-main{padding:1.5rem 2rem;border-right:1px solid var(--border)}
.exp-date{font-family:'Space Mono',monospace;font-size:10px;color:var(--red);letter-spacing:.12em;margin-bottom:.5rem}
.exp-co{font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:1.45rem;letter-spacing:.04em;line-height:1.1}
.exp-role{font-size:12px;color:var(--gray);margin-top:.3rem}
.exp-side{padding:1.5rem 2rem;display:flex;align-items:center}
.exp-desc{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--gray);line-height:1.7}

/* Skills */
.skills-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}
.sk-item{padding:2.5rem 2rem;border-right:1px solid var(--border);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);transition:all .25s}
.sk-item:hover{background:var(--black);color:var(--white)}
.sk-item:hover .sk-sub{color:rgba(255,255,255,.4)}
.sk-item:hover .sk-num{color:var(--red)}
.sk-num{font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:3.5rem;color:var(--border);line-height:1;transition:color .25s}
.sk-name{font-weight:500;margin-top:.5rem;font-size:14px}
.sk-sub{font-size:10px;color:var(--gray);margin-top:.2rem;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;transition:color .25s}

/* Projects */
.proj-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
.proj-item{padding:3rem 2.5rem;border-right:1px solid var(--border);transition:all .25s}
.proj-item:hover{background:var(--black);color:var(--white)}
.proj-item:hover .proj-year,.proj-item:hover .proj-desc{color:rgba(255,255,255,.5)}
.proj-year{font-family:'Space Mono',monospace;font-size:10px;color:var(--red);letter-spacing:.18em;margin-bottom:1rem}
.proj-name{font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:3rem;line-height:.93;letter-spacing:.04em;margin-bottom:1.2rem}
.proj-desc{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--gray);line-height:1.75;max-width:320px;transition:color .25s}
.proj-tag{display:inline-block;margin-top:1.2rem;padding:.35rem 1rem;border:1px solid currentColor;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;opacity:.7}

/* Lang */
.lang-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}
.lang-item{padding:2.5rem 2rem;border-right:1px solid var(--border);text-align:center}
.lang-name{font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:2.2rem;letter-spacing:.06em}
.lang-bar{height:3px;background:var(--border);margin:.8rem 0 .5rem;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.lang-fill{height:100%;background:var(--red);position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:0;transition:width 1.4s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1)}
.lang-level{font-size:11px;color:var(--gray);letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase}

/* Interests */
.int-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}
.int-item{padding:2rem 2rem;border-right:1px solid var(--border)}
.int-n{font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:2rem;color:var(--red);margin-bottom:.5rem}
.int-t{font-size:13px;color:var(--gray);line-height:1.6}

/* Contact */
#contact{min-height:58vh;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;text-align:center;padding:5rem 2rem;border-bottom:none}
.contact-huge{font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:clamp(3.5rem,10vw,9rem);line-height:.85;letter-spacing:.04em}
.contact-huge .red{color:var(--red)}
.contact-sub{margin:2rem 0;color:var(--gray);font-size:13px;max-width:380px;line-height:1.8}
.contact-links{display:flex;gap:2.5rem;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center}
.cl{color:var(--black);text-decoration:none;font-family:'Space Mono',monospace;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.1em;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);padding-bottom:2px;transition:all .25s}
.cl:hover{color:var(--red);border-color:var(--red)}

/* Footer */
footer{padding:1.2rem 2.5rem;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;border-top:1px solid var(--border);font-size:11px;color:var(--gray);font-family:'Space Mono',monospace}

/* Reveal */
.reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(20px);transition:opacity .7s ease,transform .7s ease}
.reveal.in{opacity:1;transform:none}

@keyframes up{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(24px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
@keyframes marquee{from{transform:translateX(0)}to{transform:translateX(-50%)}}

@media(max-width:768px){
  #hero{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .hero-right{height:55vw}
  nav ul{display:none}
  .about-body,.proj-grid,.lang-grid,.int-grid,.skills-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .exp-item{grid-template-columns:50px 1fr}
  .exp-side{display:none}
  .s-head{grid-template-columns:50px 1fr}
  .s-num{writing-mode:horizontal-tb}
  h1{font-size:4.5rem}
  .contact-huge{font-size:3.5rem}
}
</style>
</head>

<script>
const nav = document.getElementById('nav');
window.addEventListener('scroll', () => nav.classList.toggle('scrolled', scrollY > 60));

const obs = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
  entries.forEach((e, i) => {
    if (e.isIntersecting) setTimeout(() => e.target.classList.add('in'), i * 80);
  });
}, { threshold: 0.08 });
document.querySelectorAll('.reveal').forEach(el => obs.observe(el));

const lobs = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
  entries.forEach(e => {
    if (e.isIntersecting) {
      e.target.querySelectorAll('.lang-fill').forEach(b => { b.style.width = b.dataset.w + '%'; });
    }
  });
}, { threshold: 0.3 });
document.querySelectorAll('.lang-grid').forEach(el => lobs.observe(el));
</script>
